pkgmetadata.longdescription: HASS-data-detective explores and analyses the data a Home Assistant installation records. It opens the recorder database through SQLAlchemy, loads states and events into a pandas DataFrame and adds helpers for entities, timelines and attributes; the intended way to drive it is a Jupyter notebook. It is a companion of a running Home Assistant rather than one of its dependencies, so it is filed in app-misc beside homeassistant-full. Upstream's auto-discovery looks only for /config (when HASSIO_TOKEN is set) or ~/.homeassistant; on Gentoo the config directory must be passed explicitly - the Home Assistant this overlay installs uses /etc/homeassistant. That recorder runs in WAL mode, so a normal user must work on a copy of the database (or run as the homeassistant user) instead of opening the live file.
